notes.title: Update Ver1.0.4
notes.content: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][p]・Fixed a bug where dummy images weren't masked when “Change Appearance”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/f48b98cccb19cd29aff9321a254170275c541104.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.3
notes.content: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][p]・Added the ability to change character colors after creation[/p][p]・Added the ability to change equipment at the Adventurers' Guild[/p][p]・Added the ability to view the Item Index anywhere[/p][p]・Added the ability to check monster stats during battle[/p][p]・Changed so characters blown away by enemy monsters' “gust of wind” return to the party immediately after battle[/p][p]・Shortened the effect when using “Slash” on the field[/p][p]・Changed the design of the icon indicating your current location on the map[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/f48b98cccb19cd29aff9321a254170275c541104.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.2
notes.content: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Crude medicine” could not be used on the field under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the power of the “Fighter” skill ‘Charge’[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed so that the “Unlock Door” skill automatically activates when touching a key door[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the map UI[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/ac5f978ea9a478890906cd0bcb9bf4161e39f414.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.1
notes.content: [p]The following updates have been implemented.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where doors not within the player's field of view were mapped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some UI glitches during combat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where BGM would not play after using “Onsoku”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Elixir” and “Crude medicine” could not be used in the field[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Undead afflicted with status ailments were not affected by ‘Dispel’ and “Disenchant”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “Unlock Door” skill could still be used to force open doors even if the user was incapacitated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with message display when attempting to remove cursed equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rapidly pressing keys during a saved game load could corrupt the data.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the order of held items would sometimes become scrambled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spell effects were not displayed when using books.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the current quantity of items was not displayed when buying or selling items.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted item drop rates.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted parameters and spawn rates for “Dark Hero”.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the drop item for “Dancing Coin”.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character creation to highlight insufficient stats in red.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ‘Onsoku’ to be usable only once per battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the extinguishing speed of “Torch”.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo version update Ver. 0.5.1
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed an issue with Chinese and Korean input on SteamDeck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where multiple items could not be purchased in the store[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [list][*][p]Support for French, German, and Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of tutorial messages[/p][/*][*][p]Addition and modification of some graphics and effects[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of settings items[/p][/*][*][p]Key response fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Price adjustments for some items[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo version update Ver. 0.4.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where party members would disappear under certain conditions when the third party member joined.
[*] Fixed an issue where the title screen would display color bars when playing on Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could be selected in excess of the available stock when purchasing items in the shop.
[*] Assigned the “Back” function to the Escape key.
[*] Adjusted game speed.
[*] Added auto-save functionality.
[*] Added a load screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo version update Ver. 0.4.3
notes.content:
Fixed UI corruption in the Adventurer's Guild.
Fixed a bug that freezes when using an item with 1 item in possession.
